mapper.delete: delete from `corgi`.`corgi_activity_like` where activity_id = #{activityId} and like_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select `like_user_id` likeUserId, `like_user_name` likeUserName, `like_user_avatar` likeUserAvatar, `activity_id` activityId, `ctime` from corgi_activity_like where activity_id = #{activityId} order by id desc

select `like_user_id` likeUserId, `like_user_name` likeUserName, `like_user_avatar` likeUserAvatar from corgi_activity_like l join corgi_user_follow f on f.follow_user_id = l.like_user_id and f.user_id= #{userId} where activity_id = #{activityId} order by l.id desc limit 3
